## <span style="color: #8b5cf6;">📚 Overview</span>

<img align="right" src="https://img.shields.io/badge/LLM-Clichés-purple?style=flat-square" alt="LLM Clichés">

This repository contains a curated collection of clichés, overused phrases, and repetitive patterns frequently produced by Large Language Models. The corpus serves as a valuable resource for researchers, developers, and content creators working to identify and improve AI-generated content quality.

<br clear="right"/>

## <span style="color: #06b6d4;">🚀 Getting Started</span>

<details open>
<summary><b style="color: #8b5cf6;">Quick Start Guide</b></summary>

<br>

### Installation

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/jeanl/AIStoryHub_LLM_Cliche_Corpus.git

# Navigate to the directory
cd AIStoryHub_LLM_Cliche_Corpus
```

### Usage

```python
# Load the corpus
import json

with open('llm_cliche_corpus.json', 'r') as f:
    cliches = json.load(f)

# Use in your application
for cliche in cliches:
    print(cliche)
```

</details>
